# dsh-plugin-cost-meter
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that puts a **live cost badge in the conversation header (top-right)** and
prices every request with **peak / off-peak (time-of-day) tiers**.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features

- **Live** — the badge updates as the host reports provider usage; no polling, no timers.
- **Histor
ically correct** — each request is priced by its **own wall-clock timestamp**, so a session that spa

ns peak and off-peak stays accurate even if the page sits open overnight.
- **Weekday-aware peak tie
rs** — DeepSeek bills peak only **Monday–Friday**; weekends are off-peak all day. The schedule is co

nfigurable (windows, weekdays, multiplier, time zone).
- **Silent price sync** — a bundled price cat
alog plus an out-of-band remote catalog refreshed on an interval. Push a new `catalog/prices.json` a
nd every installed copy picks it up **without a plugin release**; a failed refresh keeps the last go

od rates.
- **Explicit peak/off-peak rates** — models may carry an explicit discounted pair (`cacheM

iss` + `cacheMissOffPeak`), not just a multiplier.
- **Route-aware matching** — `provider/model`, `p

rovider/*`, `*`-model wildcards, and case/space/punctuation-insensitive model ids.
- **Never fakes a
number** — an unpriced route renders `未配置` (`unpriced`) instead of a made-up fallback rate.

## Configure
The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row with defaults. Override it by adding a `cost-m
eter` row with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch
ow with the same `id` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

Two rate styles are accepted everywhere:
- **Catalog style** (peak base + optional off-peak): `cacheMiss`, `cacheHit`, `cacheWrite`, `output`

, and `cacheMissOffPeak`, `cacheHitOffPeak`, `cacheWriteOffPeak`, `outputOffPeak`.
- **Legacy style*
* (off-peak base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Pea
base): `inputPerM`, `cacheReadPerM`, `cacheWritePerM`, `outputPerM` (with optional `*Peak` fields).
## Automatic price updates
Prices resolve in this order (highest wins):

1. `config.models` / `config.default`
2. `config.pricingUrl` (legacy document)
3. the **remote catal
og** at `config.catalogUrl` — default: this package's own `catalog/prices.json` on GitHub, derived f

rom `package.json.repository`
4. the **bundled** `catalog/prices.json` (offline fallback)
A timer re-reads the remote catalog and `pricingUrl` every `refreshMinutes` (default 6 hours) and sw
aps the live table in place:

- a failed refresh **keeps the last successful data**;
- a source that never loaded does not clear a

nything;
- **historical amounts are frozen**: a sample is priced when it is folded and the amount is
stored, so a price change applies only to samples folded after it — a past session's total is never

rewritten;
- the frozen amounts ride the persisted projection cache, so they survive restarts; only
a cold replay without a checkpoint prices the log at the then-current table.
This makes the catalog the single place to maintain rates: **edit and push `catalog/prices.json`, an
d installed copies update themselves** — no new plugin release. Forks get their own update channel a
utomatically because the default URL is derived from `package.json.repository`.
To point at a private mirror or a local file, set `catalogUrl` (`https://…`, a path, or `file:///…`)
. Set it to `""` to disable remote syncing.
## Peak / off-peak

- Tiering uses the **request's own `event.time`**, never "now".
- Peak applies only on the configure

d weekdays (`days`, default Monday–Friday); weekends are off-peak all day.
- The schedule comes from
the catalog's `peakSchedule` (time zone, days, windows, off-peak ratio) and can be overridden field

by field in `config.peak`.
- `peak.enabled: false` bills one flat rate; `peak.timezoneOffsetMinutes
` shifts the wall clock for the window check.
The hover tooltip shows the current tier, the multiplier, the route, and the token breakdown.
## Pricing model
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Totals are accumulated per `{ provider, model }` route and per tier, so switching models mid-session
keeps each route on its own price. A repeated usage sample for the same `(turn, step)` replaces the
earlier one instead of double-counting.

The badge uses the additive `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot; `…header.corner` is a `sin
gle` slot already occupied by a shipped plugin.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`test/contract.test.mjs` covers the projection contract, weekday peak, catalog parsing, explicit dua
l rates, currency conversion, normalization/wildcards, unpriced routes, and manual overrides. It run
s offline (`catalogUrl: ""`).
## Notes

- Costs are **estimates**: they depend on the provider-reported `usage` and on the price table.
- Th

e badge is **per session**; it does not aggregate sub-sessions or the whole account.
- The bundled c
atalog is a dated snapshot — verify it against the official pricing page and update `catalog/prices.

json` when rates change.
- The plugin is a Web surface plugin; compositions without `sessionProjecti
ons` (e.g. headless) skip registration.
